en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ‘Abdillāh Al-Barqi, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Washā, who said:

I asked Imam Riďā (a.s.), “What are the rewards for those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of your father, Abil Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.))?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Go to his Ziyārah!” I asked, “What are its merits?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “The same as those for going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
